findings.desc: Lattice-Parallel-Development-Capability.md:147 and Lattice-Parallel-Development-Capability.md:167-176 [MEDIUM] The new integration section says a frozen Parallel Development input can come from `parallel_wave_create / parallel_plan / parallel_report`, then immediately requires snapshot fields like `waveHash`, `materialHash`, `sharedContractVersion`, `createdFromCommands`, and `createdAt`. That conflicts with docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-parallel-wave.md:82-134, which says only create/inspect/plan carry the full wave envelope and `parallel_report` is a projection that omits core fields such as `storyRefs`, `hostCandidates`, top-level `evidenceRefs`, and raw `mergeOrder`. Future implementers could choose `parallel_report` as the binding artifact and then have to invent or re-derive the missing contract. Clarify which artifact is allowed to seed the frozen snapshot and whether the required fields come from existing Wave output or from a coordinator-added wrapper.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in commit b85c7a52: recommended composition now uses parallel_wave_create --output wave.json, marks parallel_report as human-readable summary only, restricts frozen snapshot seeding to full-envelope surfaces, and separates coordinator-added freeze metadata from current Wave fields. Re-verified with git diff --check and lattice parallel_wave_create --format=json.

findings.desc: Lattice-Parallel-Development-Capability.md:147 WHY medium: the recommended composition lists `parallel_report` as a valid frozen-wave input, then the section immediately reasons about `storyRefs`, `hostCandidates`, `mergeOrder`, and required fields like `waveHash`/`materialHash`/`createdFromCommands` as if that snapshot already carries the full contract. But docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-parallel-wave.md:82 and :129 say `parallel_report` is a projection that omits top-level `storyRefs`, `hostCandidates`, `evidenceRefs`, and raw `mergeOrder`, and the current Wave contract does not guarantee `waveHash`, `materialHash`, or `createdFromCommands`. Reword to distinguish existing Wave outputs from future coordinator-added freeze metadata, or limit the entrypoint list to the full-envelope surfaces.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in commit b85c7a52: the section no longer treats parallel_report as the binding artifact and explicitly distinguishes full-envelope Wave artifact fields from future coordinator-added freeze metadata. Re-verified with git diff --check and lattice parallel_wave_create --format=json.

findings.desc: Lattice-Parallel-Development-Capability.md:176 WHY medium: the section now correctly excludes projection-only surfaces, but it still says the frozen snapshot fields from the full-envelope Wave artifact include `waveSchemaVersion`. That conflicts with the very next allowed seed surface list at :158-163 plus docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-parallel-wave.md:82-101 and the current `lattice parallel_wave_create --format=json` output, where `parallel_wave_create` carries `schemaVersion` and `generatedAt` but not `waveSchemaVersion`. An implementer following this text could still treat `parallel_wave_create` as missing a required field and invent or re-derive schema metadata. Split the required fields by surface, or require `schemaVersion` from create and `waveSchemaVersion` only when the source artifact is inspect/plan.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in commit e585465b: frozen snapshot fields now say schemaVersion or waveSchemaVersion, and the new schema marker rule explicitly states parallel_wave_create provides schemaVersion/generatedAt while inspect/plan provide waveSchemaVersion. Re-verified with git diff --check and live lattice parallel_wave_create --format=json field extraction.

findings.desc: Lattice-Parallel-Development-Capability.md:158-180 [MEDIUM] B-7110:F-001 is only partially resolved. The new section correctly limits frozen-snapshot seeds to full-envelope Wave surfaces and demotes `parallel_report` to summary-only, but it still says the frozen snapshot fields from any allowed full-envelope artifact include `waveSchemaVersion`. That conflicts with docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-parallel-wave.md:82-100 and the live `lattice parallel_wave_create --format=json` output, where `parallel_wave_create` exposes `schemaVersion` and `generatedAt` but not `waveSchemaVersion`; only `parallel_wave_inspect` and `parallel_plan` add `waveSchemaVersion`. Future implementers can still choose `parallel_wave_create` per the capability doc and then fail to satisfy the documented frozen snapshot contract. Fix by either requiring inspect/plan when `waveSchemaVersion` is mandatory, or by documenting that the coordinator freeze wrapper derives/normalizes this field when the seed artifact is `parallel_wave_create`.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in commit e585465b: the document no longer implies parallel_wave_create has waveSchemaVersion; it records the source-surface schema marker distinction and preserves original source artifact/source command in coordinator freeze wrapper wording. Re-verified with git diff --check and live lattice parallel_wave_create --format=json field extraction.
